item.title: Weather Dashboard
item.description:
Setting up a Weather Dashboard is a common project on the Raspberry Pi. There are many ways to accomplish this.

I have recently found a very nice project that makes it very simple to display detailed weather information.

The setup allows for tons of configuration and is also very simple to customize since it is just HTML/JS/CSS.

Here is an example that I have setup to demonstrate.

Pi Lab's Current Weather Conditions


If you are looking to setup a Weather Dashboard this project is definitely worth a look.

item.title: Pi Dashboard
item.description:
If you are looking for an easy way to display your Raspberry Pi's metrics in real time look no further.

The installation couldn't be simpler. If you already have a webserver and PHP configured on your Raspberry Pi you simply have to put the files in a sub-directory of your website and it just works!

I have installed it on the 5 production nodes of Pi Lab. Check it out here: pilab.dev/Node-1

The project is available on GitHub and is definitely worth a look.

Update: I have updated the Node Name in the footer of Pi Lab to link to the Pi Dashboard that has been setup for each node.

item.title: Prometheus & Grafana
item.description:
I have been wanting to track more data related to the Pi Lab nodes. After a lot of research I decided to use Prometheus and Grafana.

The results are really awesome!

I have updated the Pi Lab Stats page to incorporate these dashboards.

If you are interested in how I set this up check out this GitHub repo. https://github.com/bhemar/raspberry-metrics.

item.title: Resources
item.description:
This is a list of various resources that I have found to be useful.

Raspberry Pi

  • Raspberry Pi Foundation -- The Official Raspberry Pi site.
  • Pi My Life Up -- Tons of great tutorials.
  • Raspberry Pi Spy -- Great resources for all things Raspberry Pi.
  • Raspberry Pi Web Server -- Information on running a Raspberry Pi web server.
  • Pi-hole -- No more ads!
  • PiVPN -- Securely access your Pi from anywhere.
  • The MagPi -- Free digital book downloads.

Bludit

  • Bludit -- Awesome flat file CMS!
  • Bludit Themes -- Official Bludit themes.
  • Bludit Documentation -- Everything you need to know about Bludit.
  • Bludit Forums -- Bludit community.
  • Bludit Showcase -- Real world Bludit sites in action.

Misc. Development

  • GitHub -- Version control. Must have for all developers.
  • Vagrant -- Virtualized local development.
  • Ansible -- Automate, automate, automate.
  • Prometheus -- Gather and track server metrics.
  • Grafana -- Create awesome dashboards to visualize your metrics.

item.title: RaspController Android
item.description:
RaspController is one of the many tools that I use for managing Pi Lab.

My Favorite Features:

  • File manager
  • Shell SSH
  • Cpu, Ram, Disk monitoring
  • Info Raspberry PI
  • Shutdown
  • Reboot

I really find it useful for monitoring Pi Lab when I am away from home. I can check temperatures, system load, and even SSH into each device.

If you have a Raspberry Pi and want to manage it remotely from your phone I highly recommend RaspController.

Note: For remote access the Raspberry Pi(s) will need to be accessible either via port forwarding or by having a VPN setup on your network.

The RaspController PRO Key is only $2.99 and is totally worth it to support the development of this fantastic app!
